title: Scissors

inlines.v: SCISSORS, noun siz'zors, plural [Latin scissor, from scindo, to cut, Gr.] A cutting instrument resembling shears, but smaller, consisting of two cutting blades movable on a pin in the center, by which they are fastened. Hence we usually say, a pair of scissors
